column3: The socket keeps one retry chain: open() cancels the pending backoff timer and any wait for visibility, and Reconnect now and the online event call dialNow(), which is a no-op while a dial is in flight
column4: XIN-23 measured 8 /v1/socket dials per 30 s after three Reconnect now presses, against 2 before; every dial is a Worker request plus a DO auth check
